consequence.statement: An optional field was added to the schema. Existing GitRepository objects stay valid, and nothing changes unless the new field is set.

original.statement: The source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 GitRepository CRD schema gains a new field, spec.serviceAccountName.

decision.reason: Comparing the v2.6.4 [ev-782bc47d120d] and v2.7.0 [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] install bundles shows only one change: spec.serviceAccountName was added to the GitRepository v1 schema. Nothing is removed or restricted, and no evidence says that existing objects fail, are rejected or are ignored. The deterministic canonical validator confirmed that this added field has no consequence for existing environments, so a consequence of 'none' (informational) is supported. The excerpts shown do not prove that the field is optional rather than required, so confidence is low.
